name: SAP Sync Agent
fn: Real-time AR data sync from SAP FI-AR (open items, customer master, aging)
detail: Continuously syncs AR data from SAP FI-AR — open items, customer master and aging — across all five company codes via BAPI/IDoc and CDS views. Keeps every module working from one clean, current data set.
sap: SAP S/4HANA · FI-AR · CDS analytical views · BAPI / IDoc integration
